description: Execute a cross-border or domestic payment settlement. Use this to move money between currencies (USD→EUR, USD→GBP) or settle same-currency on-chain (USD→USD skips FX fee). Covers: vendor payments, treasury transfers, intercompany settlements, foreign payroll, agent-to-agent payments. The Settlement Agent autonomously checks oracle stability and local rail health before executing — if conditions are unsafe it returns a held status with reasoning rather than failing silently. Returns settlement ID, status (executed/held/sandbox/failed), tx hash, net amount, total fees, oracle status, and AI reasoning for the decision. IMPORTANT: Runs in sandbox mode by default (real calculations, no funds moved). Set sandbox=false only for live execution.

destinationCurrency.description: Destination currency: USD, EUR, GBP, USDC, EURC. Use same as sourceCurrency for domestic/intra-country settlements (no FX fee).

purpose.description: Payment purpose: intercompany, vendor-payment, payroll, treasury

quoteId.description: Pre-fetched quoteId from get_quote (optional — agent fetches if omitted)

referenceId.description: External reference ID (invoice number, TMS ID, etc.)

sandbox.description: Sandbox mode: real calculations, no on-chain execution. Default: true. Set false for live settlement.

sourceCurrency.description: Source currency: USD, EUR, GBP, USDC, EURC

name: settlement.execute
